decisions.reason: As a newly launched desk system with its own page, it reflects visible investment in a core furniture category, so management is likely to continue backing it.
A chair family is central to a furniture maker’s range and the dedicated web presentation signals commitment that management will be reluctant to reverse so soon.
Although floor cushions made from carpets are somewhat more experimental for the firm, the dedicated presentation and very recent launch support giving it more time.
The sofa appears less prominently on the website and may be less central than desk and chair lines, but after such a recent launch management would still tend to persist.
A high standing table fits well with contemporary workspace furniture and its own product page indicates enough commitment to make withdrawal unlikely within a year.
Rugs are somewhat peripheral to the core furniture business, but the firm has publicly committed to the collection and is likely to continue rather than admit failure quickly.
